conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Hi, I'm Dr. Lee. I understand you came in with nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain again?

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Yes, it started this afternoon. I ate a little jello after my clinic visit and suddenly had that familiar pain—just like my last flare-ups.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: I see. You were discharged just three days ago, correct? And you were feeling okay until today?

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Exactly. I felt great after the last hospitalization. I thought I was past this, but it came on fast.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Your labs show your potassium is low—3.0—which can happen with vomiting. We’ve already given you some replacement, and we’re starting IV fluids.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: That makes sense. I haven’t been able to keep anything down. Is this another gastroparesis flare?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Yes, everything points to that. Your lipase, liver tests, and lactate are normal, so it’s not pancreatitis or infection. This looks like your usual pattern.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Thank goodness. I was worried it was something new. What about the IV meds I usually get?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’re giving you IV ondansetron, lorazepam, and prochlorperazine—just like before. Morphine too, if you need it for pain.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Those usually help a lot. Can I try to eat anything tonight?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Not yet. We’ll keep you on bowel rest tonight and start with small sips tomorrow if you’re feeling better.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Good morning. Your potassium is back to normal, and you haven’t vomited since last night. How are you feeling?

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Much better. The pain is gone, and I feel like I could try some food.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Great. We’ll start you on clear liquids and see how you do. If that goes well, you can advance to solids later today.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’ve tolerated the liquids well. We’re going to discharge you soon.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: That’s good news. Should I keep using my J-tube at home?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Yes, the nutrition team recommends using it to rest your stomach. Home health will help set that up.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: And what about the nausea meds? I’d like something to take at home when this happens.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: We’re giving you a prescription for ondansetron—Zofran—5 tablets to start. Your insurance doesn’t cover it, so you’ll need to pay out of pocket to try it.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Okay, I’ll try it. I already have Ativan and Tigan at home.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Right. We’re not prescribing oral morphine because it can worsen gastroparesis. But Zofran might help catch it early.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: That makes sense. Should I follow up with Dr. ___?

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Yes, please schedule an appointment with your GI specialist to discuss long-term management.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: And my thyroid meds? I’m still taking levothyroxine at night.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: Yes, continue that as usual. Your thyroid levels are stable.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Thank you. I feel much more like myself now.

conversation_lines.speaker: Doctor
conversation_lines.text: You’re welcome. We’ll get your discharge papers ready. Home health will contact you about the J-tube support.

conversation_lines.speaker: Patient
conversation_lines.text: Got it. I’ll follow all the instructions. Thanks again.
